reviews.title: Great game, few fixes
reviews.text:
Love the game, played for years! No ads, fun animations and game play. Gotta say I love the addition of new clan activities and the chrono clash!

With that said, the rate at which you summon elite fighters and fighters in the cobra/griffin factions is abysmal. I also think the timer for boss mechs should be dropped at this point with the addition of auto battle for local mechs and the ability to buy up to 60 transmitters in bulk. 

I think adding a separate space to see boss mech requests for the full clan instead of having everybody’s mechs clogging the 6 mech rule. There should be a local and guild mech area, and/or more than 6 mechs at a time.

More codes would be cool, too and more diamond/relic events. 

Side note: I think the discord link is broken for me, it won’t let me join.

reviews.title: The best mobile game to play
reviews.text: This review is coming from a player who has played for 888 days straight of the game. There is no game I’ve played in my life that has kept me coming back everyday to play and collect my rewards. The game has so much depth whether that be weapon placement, character skills, or how you decide to choose rewards each day. The game is so rewarding and is easily Free to Play. Of course games need to have micro transactions to stay open so there are some players that spend money. The events and multiplayer keeps this game alive with constant strategy to compete and become the best. Weekly events that you build your team around and the upgrades feel endless and rewarding. I strongly recommend giving it a try.

reviews.title: Chill Auto Battler
reviews.text:
F2P player for almost two years now. Game is chill and very easy to pick up. User friendly, consistent and constantly changing events, easy-to-use interface, simple gameplay. There can be small hills here and there when dealing with higher tier heroes and current events like the Technodrome, but outside of that it's a great 30-45 minute game to play everyday. If you play several hours daily,  you may run out of stuff to do, but the game itself doesn't seem to be designed for the hardcore players. You can absolutely pay to get tons of other stuff and the VIP daily will reward in kind just like any other "time based" game. 

No base building required and no way to lose resources to other guilds or factions. Seriously, try it out.

reviews.title: Starts off great, heavy p2w after a few days
reviews.text: Really enjoyed this game for the first couple days of playing and it seemed like it would be something I could continue to play without dumping loads of money into it. Then all of a sudden I finally hit the wall. I can’t progress the campaign levels or the sewers because I can’t level up my people any further because I can’t get enough gold. And you get gold by progressing the levels. I can still get gold by checking in every few hours to get a couple thousand but when it takes 20k gold to level a character one time, it would probably take a week of checking in constantly in order to get my characters leveled enough to keep progressing. Was fun for a few days but I think I’m giving up as I am not willing to dump that amount of money. Fun game though. So if you’re willing to spend the cash I’d say give it a try.

reviews.title: Overall fun! But progressively getting worse…
reviews.text: I’m level 113 now, The game is fun and always up to date but they keep releasing new fighters that seem to get more overpowered per update. For example Locke. Just way to overpowered with his freezing and crazy damage and makes him even stupider that he can resurrect, if he’s in a rhythm he can just freeze you and won’t give you an opportunity to attack until you’re dead. It’s pure RNG and if you get bad fighters you’re just screwed from the beginning. If I were to give a recommendation I would focus less on releasing new and more powerful fighters and more on different ways to focus on fighters you want to upgrade or like a challenge based system that can help unlock fragments of specific fighters or a different game mode that utilizes fighters to a different play style perhaps requiring more player interaction or decision making to rely less on rng. Anyways overall fun game with a really loving development team which you don’t see much in mobile games.

reviews.title: Casual And Very Rewarding
reviews.text:
I’ve played multiple games that always seem casual at first, but become heavily p2w the deeper you go.  I’ve played this game for a couple weeks now and never felt pressured into buying anything.  You can play the game free and still get rewarded.  Gems come easily through daily rewards, leveling up, and constant on going events with achievements that reward you gems.  Just by doing things each day, you also accumulate VIP points (FOR FREE) which give more daily rewards.  I’m sure p2w players would spend money to try and become the top player at all times, but if you don’t mind not being that competitive but still want to have a relatively good team….you can do that for free.
I don’t see myself losing interest in this game anytime soon.
